name: Podman Container Sandbox
description: Plugin #1 (epic #1516, Phase 3): lets a granted agent spawn and manage its own compose stacks through a privilege-holding broker sidecar, instead of touching the host Podman socket directly. The broker (broker/, reworked from PR #1287's podman-mcp) holds the libpod socket and stamps every container it creates with the caller's scope owner label, so two scopes sharing one broker never see or operate on each other's containers. Agents drive it with the dependency-free `aee-podman` CLI (e.g. `aee-podman compose up -f compose.yml`).
promptLine: You can spawn and manage your own container stacks through the Podman sandbox broker with `aee-podman` — run `aee-podman --help`. Containers you create are private to your scope; nothing you run is visible to other agents.
